actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent, biologically interpretable identity: strong FDR-supported RNA up-regulation of inflammatory/immune Hallmark pathways (26/50 significant, |SMD| up to 0.91) paired with a concordant CNV pattern (19/49 significant continuous features, deltas ~0.55-0.58, plus chr12p/chr20q gain and chr14q/CDKN2A loss). These two internal modalities converge on the same direction of contrast, and the WXS trend (lower PBRM1/VHL) is directionally consistent though not FDR-significant. Membership is structurally compatible: all five modalities show positive median silhouettes, patient support is moderate (median 3/5), and the fused probe is non-degenerate with moderate resampling stability. No measured technical factor provides a dominant alternative explanation (all confounder q>0.18, no deterministic flags), and known-label echo is near zero, so the candidate is not merely recapitulating stage or grade. Structural evidence does not positively support a Split (internal probe is near-zero silhouette and not a credible reproducible partition) or a Merge with C0002 (RNA boundary silhouette 0.024 and opposite-direction biology indicate the two sets are distinct). Retaining C0001 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent, biologically interpretable identity that mirrors C0001 in the opposite direction: strong FDR-supported RNA down-regulation of the same inflammatory/immune Hallmark pathways (26/50 significant, |SMD| up to 0.91) with concordant CNV lower-in-set at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/chr20q/chr12p and absence of chr12p/chr20q gain and lower chr14q/CDKN2A loss. RNA and CNV converge on the same contrast, and the WXS trend (higher PBRM1/VHL) is directionally consistent though not FDR-significant. Membership is structurally compatible: positive median silhouettes in WSI/RNA/CNV, moderate patient support (median 3/5), and a non-degenerate fused probe with moderate resampling stability. No measured technical factor dominates (all confounder q>0.18, no flags), and known-label echo is near zero. Structural evidence does not positively support a Split (near-zero internal silhouette) or a Merge with C0001 (RNA boundary silhouette 0.024 and opposite-direction biology indicate distinct identities). Retaining C0002 for downstream validation is therefore better supported than Drop.
